system.description:
Something made a deal somewhere in your bloodline. You didn't ask for this power, but you have it.

  • Bloodline Cantrips: Vicious Mockery and Toll the Dead.
  • Bloodline Ability (1st): Resistance 5 to fire.
  • Once per day when a creature damages you, it takes 1d6 fire damage for every four Sorcerer levels (minimum 1d6), no save.
  • You have Advantage on Persuasion and Deception checks involving contracts, deals, or negotiations, and always know when a written agreement contains a hidden clause.
  • Bloodline Awakening (10th): Once per day, offer a creature that understands you a binding deal of up to 25 words, never suicidal.
  • It makes a Will save or must accept.
  • If it breaks the deal it loses 3d6 HP each day, which no magic restores, until it honours the deal or Remove Curse cast by a higher-level caster ends it.
  • While it is in breach you know which way it lies while it is on your plane, and other fiends pursue it.
